module: Manager of the career's "general milestones". When the career activates, it collects via the onGeneralMilestonesCollect hook the configurations provided by subsystems (generalMilestones/*), initializes their save data ({claimedStep, notificationStep}) in career_modules_milestones_milestones.saveData.general, then calls onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks. It builds the UI entry of each milestone (getMilestone) and handles reward claiming (claim).
notes: A milestone configuration contains: id, filter, maxStep, icon, color, getValue(), getLabel(step, value, target), getDescription(...), getProgressLabel(...), getTarget(step), getRewards(step); getTarget(0) must be 0 if minValueIsPreviousStepTarget or for the progress bar.
Rewards are lists of {attributeKey, rewardAmount}; claim sums them per attribute and adds them via playerAttributes.addAttributes (tags milestone, reward, gameplay).

Probable bug: the sort at the end of onCareerActive applies to the module table `milestones` (career_modules_milestones_milestones) and not to milestoneConfigs, so it has no useful effect. The order stays the collection order.
printDebug writes milestones.csv and assumes getRewards(s) returns at least two rewards (r[1], r[2]): crashes otherwise (linear rewards give only one).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: resets and re-collects the milestone configurations (onGeneralMilestonesCollect hook), creates missing save data (warns if claimedStep is absent) and calls the onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks hook.

claim.desc: Claims the milestone's current tier: sums the rewards of getRewards(claimedStep), credits them, increments claimedStep, calls the onGeneralMilestoneClaimed(config) hook and shows a success toast.

getMilestone.desc: Builds the milestone's UI card for the next tier: label, description, progress bar, rewards, claimable (value >= target), claimFunction and claimRefreshFunction. If all tiers are done (maxStep exceeded), returns a card with completed = true.

onGetMilestones.desc: Milestone list hook: adds to list the card of each milestone whose filter contains one of the requested filters (all if the filter is empty).

printDebug.desc: Debug tool: exports all tiers (id, step, name, description, target, first two rewards) to milestones.csv.
